title: Android Enterprise App Management via Managed Google Play (Intune)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (enterprise Microsoft Android implementation).

Intune admin center / Microsoft Graph / managed Google Play / Google Admin console authored at exact detail from Microsoft & Google public docs. The Android Management API (AMAPI) transition, web/account-driven enrollment, and whether a change triggers device RE-ENROLLMENT are actively evolving — cited or flagged 'verify against current Microsoft guidance / your tenant', never asserted from memory or invented. OEM (Samsung Knox/Zebra) + third-party apps at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell (Graph); no hardcoded credentials/secrets. No client names.
hook: Deliver and manage Android apps through managed Google Play
problem: On Android Enterprise, apps flow through managed Google Play — and doing it well means the right app types, configs, and update control. This solution covers Android app management in Intune: approving and assigning store, private (LOB), and web apps via managed Google Play, managed app configuration, app protection policies, update/track control, and per-enrollment-model assignment — so users get the apps they need, configured and controlled.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — app types on managed Google Play (store/private/web), managed configuration, protection, and update-track control across enrollment models.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Intune + Android Enterprise + managed Google Play binding, admin roles, app sources).

Implementation Guide — approve + assign store/private/web apps, apply managed configurations + app protection, set update tracks, and target by enrollment model / group — pilot-first, each app/config named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Microsoft Graph / Intune automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (apps deliver, configs apply, updates controlled) plus Best Practices for a governed managed Google Play app catalog.
short: Deliver and manage Android apps through managed Google Play in Intune — store/private/web apps, managed configuration, app protection, and update-track control across enrollment models — so users get apps configured and controlled. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
